about: Popular names for provisions, which their text does not use. find_provision in tools/mcp_server.py matches these before the headings and the text. Each entry lists the provisions the name refers to and a note on why; add entries as they come up. Entries with "scope" instead of "paths" name a body of law (an abbreviation in a citation, such as "GG" or "CFA"); find_provision then searches only there.
